description: RC4.3: the GI denoiser through a real scene change (two-room's lamp moves): with the history clamp and the soft change reset on and off, how long the denoised irradiance takes to reach its new converged value, and how much it changes frame to frame meanwhile (history kept, not dropped). A measurement with gates on the defaults only: settles within 16 frames, and no device errors or bad values.
